query_ground_truth.workflow_task: We are restructuring our product roadmap boards and need to set up a new tracking column on Trello for incoming security reviews. Once that list is established, check our ongoing ClickUp chat communications regarding the Q3 compliance audit and post a summary update to the team chat channel to keep everyone aligned on the new workflow.
query_ground_truth.query: send a message to the ClickUp team chat channel about the compliance audit update
query_ground_truth.rationale: Posts the status update message to the ClickUp chat channel.

request.query: send a message to the ClickUp team chat channel about the compliance audit update

results.use_case: send a message to the ClickUp team chat channel about the compliance audit update
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if workspace identifier is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover available workspaces using CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES (pick the correct context before posting).
[Optional (if channel identifier is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: List available chat channels using CLICKUP_GET_CHAT_CHANNELS (find the destination channel to post into).
[Required] [Step]: Post the new chat message using CLICKUP_CREATE_CHAT_MESSAGE (send the provided content to the chosen channel).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Retrieve the latest channel messages using CLICKUP_GET_CHAT_MESSAGES (confirm the new message appears as expected).
[Optional (if you must correct content)] [Next Step]: Modify the posted message using CLICKUP_UPDATE_CHAT_MESSAGE (fix the message after posting).
[Optional (if a mistaken post must be removed)] [Fallback]: Delete the message using CLICKUP_DELETE_CHAT_MESSAGE (remove the message when editing is insufficient).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_GET_CHAT_MESSAGES] Message results may be nested under a data array; parse the correct field rather than assuming a top-level list.
[CLICKUP_CREATE_CHAT_MESSAGE] Requires consistent content and content_format/type inputs; mismatches can cause posting failures or unintended rendering.
[CLICKUP_UPDATE_CHAT_MESSAGE] Requires the message identifier from the create/list response; retain it if you may need to edit or delete later.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clickup. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clickup") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clickup tools.

CLICKUP_CREATE_CHAT_MESSAGE.description: Tool to send a message in a ClickUp chat channel. Use when you need to post messages to team chat channels. Supports both regular messages and structured posts with optional assignments, followers, and reactions.

type.description: The type of message: 'message' for regular text messages, 'post' for structured posts.

content.description: The full content of the message to be created. Supports markdown formatting.

assignee.description: The user ID of the person to assign this message to.

followers.description: List of user IDs to follow this message (max 10).

date.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the reaction was added.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who added the reaction.

reactions.description: Reactions to add to the message at creation time (max 10).

channel_id.description: The ID of the Channel where the message will be sent.

group_assignee.description: The group ID to assign this message to.

triaged_action.description: The triaged action applied to the message: 1 or 2.

triaged_object_id.description: The message triaged action object ID.

triaged_object_type.description: The message triaged action object type.

CLICKUP_GET_CHAT_CHANNELS.description: Tool to retrieve chat channels in a ClickUp workspace. Use when you need to list available chat channels, DMs, or group chats in a workspace. Supports pagination via cursor and filtering by follower status, closed channels, and recent activity.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to fetch for this page.

cursor.description: Used to request the next page of results.

is_follower.description: Only return Channels the user is following.

channel_types.description: Specify the types of Channels to return from the request.

include_closed.description: Include DMs/Group DMs that have been explicitly closed.

with_message_since.description: Only return Channels with at least one message since the given timestamp (Unix milliseconds).

CLICKUP_GET_CHAT_CHANNEL.description: Retrieves details for a specific chat channel in a ClickUp Workspace. Use when you need information about a particular chat channel.

channel_id.description: The ID of the specified Channel.

description_format.description: Format options for the channel description.
